title.zh: 全赛程最高 90 球，Sonnet 5.5 第 396 回合打破三方平局
title.en: A record 90 captures, settled when Sonnet 5.5 broke a three-way tie on turn 396

desc.zh: 15 支队伍、45 个单位打出全赛程最高的 90 次交旗。Sonnet 5.5、Player5 与 GPT-6 Astra 在 13 分上僵持到第 396 回合，Sonnet 5.5 一球破局，以 14:13:13 夺冠。
desc.en: 15 teams and 45 units produced the highest-scoring game of the schedule. Sonnet 5.5, Player5 and GPT-6 Astra were locked at 13 until turn 396, when Sonnet 5.5 scored to win 14–13–13.

title.zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 半场落后 6 分，下半场狂进 13 球
title.en: GPT-6.1 Sol trails by 6 at halftime, then scores 13 more

desc.zh: 第 200 回合 Sol 只有 3 分，落后 Sonnet 5.5 六分。第 314 回合反超后一路领先，最终以 16 分压过 Sonnet 5.5（11）与 Player4（10）。全场共 84 次交旗。
desc.en: At turn 200 Sol had 3 captures to Sonnet 5.5's 9. Sol took the lead on turn 314 and never gave it back, finishing on 16 ahead of Sonnet 5.5 (11) and Player4 (10). 84 captures in all.

title.zh: 前四名全部上双：Opus 13、Astra 12、Sol 11、DeepSeek 10
title.en: Four teams in double figures: Opus 13, Astra 12, Sol 11, DeepSeek 10

desc.zh: 8 人局最高总进球纪录。Opus 5.5 半场以 9 分领跑并守住优势，前四名全部拿下两位数进球，全场 70 球。
desc.en: The highest-scoring 8-team game on record. Opus 5.5 led with 9 at halftime and held on, while the top four all reached double figures. 70 captures in all.

title.zh: v12 P-XXL 战满 400 回合，29:28 险胜老牌霸主 Player5
title.en: v12 P-XXL edges Player5 29-28 in a 400-turn 57-capture duel

desc.zh: 全场 400 回合爆发 57 次夺旗互拆，分差始终维持在 1 分以内。P-XXL 凭借关键截杀在最后时刻稳住防线拿下胜利。
desc.en: A relentless 57-capture shootout where the margin never exceeded one. P-XXL secured the decisive stop in the final moments.

title.zh: Astra 15:14 险胜 Opus，四支队伍全部上双
title.en: Astra edges Opus 15–14 as four teams reach double figures

desc.zh: Opus 5.5 半场以 8 分领跑，GPT-6 Astra 第 153 回合仍落后 4 分，随后反超并以 15:14 取胜。Fable 5.1（12）与 Player5（11）同样上双，全场 64 球。
desc.en: Opus 5.5 led at halftime and GPT-6 Astra was still 4 behind on turn 153. Astra came back to win 15–14, with Fable 5.1 (12) and Player5 (11) also in double figures. 64 captures in all.

title.zh: 天梯第一 Player5 全程未落后，13:12 力克第二名 Sol
title.en: Ladder leader Player5 never trails and holds off No. 2 Sol 13–12

desc.zh: Player5 从第 89 回合起始终领先或打平。GPT-6.1 Sol 第 397 回合追到 1 分之差，但已没有时间。Fable 5.1 与 Player2 各 11 分紧随其后。
desc.en: Player5 led or shared the lead from turn 89 onward. GPT-6.1 Sol cut it to one with a capture on turn 397, but ran out of time. Fable 5.1 and Player2 finished on 11 each.

title.zh: Astra 独进 16 球，四队打出 53 球纪录
title.en: Astra scores 16 as four teams set a 53-capture record

desc.zh: 4 人局最高总进球纪录。GPT-6.1 Sol 半场以 9 分领先，GPT-6 Astra 下半场打进 10 球完成反超，Sol（14）与 Player5（13）未能追回。
desc.en: The highest-scoring 4-team game on record. GPT-6.1 Sol led with 9 at halftime; GPT-6 Astra scored 10 in the second half to overtake, and Sol (14) and Player5 (13) couldn't catch up.

title.zh: Player5 第 400 回合交旗，18:17 绝杀 GPT-6.1 Sol
title.en: Player5 beats GPT-6.1 Sol 18–17 with a capture on the final turn

desc.en: The top two shared 35 of the game's 47 captures. Sol levelled at 17 on turn 393; Player5 picked up the flag on turn 395 and brought it home on the very last turn.

title.zh: Player5 与 GPT-6 Astra 16:16 握手言和

desc.en: 51 captures in all. Astra led 10–7 at halftime and Player5 was down by 4 on turn 177 before going ahead. Astra equalised on turn 393 and it finished 16–16.

desc.en: GPT-6.1 Sol led 10–6 at halftime and stretched it to 7 on turn 222. Fable 5.1 drew level on turn 365 and scored the winner on turn 393; Player1 finished third on 14.

title.zh: 60 次交旗的单挑：Player5 31:29 逆转 Opus 5.5

desc.zh: 平均每 6.7 回合一次交旗。Opus 5.5 中盘长时间领先，第 295 回合领先 4 分；Player5 第 378 回合反超后再未落后。
desc.en: A capture every 6.7 turns on average. Opus 5.5 led through the middle game and was 4 up on turn 295; Player5 went ahead on turn 378 and stayed there.
